modes.title: Interview notes
modes.prompt: The customer runs a neighborhood grocery store with average daily revenue of about RMB 18,000. They seek RMB 500,000 for peak-season inventory over 12 months. The customer owns a home, has not confirmed whether collateral is acceptable, and wants to understand feasible options soon.

result.need: RMB 500,000 in working capital for peak-season inventory over 12 months; collateral preference still needs confirmation.
result.match: Prioritize assessment of a small-business working-capital facility. Amount, rate, term, and security remain subject to formal approval.
result.action: Confirm six months of operating cash flow, current liabilities, and collateral preference; collect the business license and key operating records.

modes.title: Customer screening
modes.prompt: Filter for customers with stable operating cash flow over the last 90 days, no current business loan with our bank, and no follow-up in the last 30 days. Exclude customers who opted out of marketing or carry a high-risk flag.

result.need: Create a prioritized outreach list focused on customers with stable operations who have not been contacted recently.
result.match: Tag possible directions such as working capital or business expansion without drawing a credit conclusion at the screening stage.
result.action: Review marketing consent and risk flags, confirm priority, then prepare first-contact talking points and follow-up tasks.

modes.title: Document review
modes.prompt: Available: identity document, business license, and six months of bank statements. To confirm: premises evidence, loan-purpose documents, and spouse information.

result.need: Core identity and business documents are available; operating and income details can move to manual verification.
result.match: Document completeness supports preliminary product matching, while missing items may affect specific eligibility conditions.
result.action: Check OCR fields against originals, collect premises, purpose, and related-party documents where required, and record each source.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Key points about AI assistance, data handling, and day-to-day business use.

items.question: Can an AI-generated product suggestion be used as a credit decision?
items.answer: No. The workspace structures information and supports product matching; it does not replace credit approval. Final amount, rate, term, security, and approval remain subject to the formal process.

items.question: Do OCR and interview outputs require human review?
items.answer: Yes. Original information, structured output, and open items remain visible so a relationship manager can verify them before the next step.

items.question: Does the system automatically send marketing messages?
items.answer: No. It only creates editable script suggestions. A relationship manager must confirm customer consent, marketing restrictions, and content before sending.

items.question: How should sensitive customer data be managed?
items.answer: A production deployment should use role-based access, masking, access controls, and audit logs in line with the institution's applicable policies.

items.question: Can it integrate with existing business systems?
items.answer: Yes. The roadmap supports authorized integration with credit data, bank core data, approval workflows, enterprise messaging, and business analytics.

faq.tip: This page describes product capabilities and does not constitute a credit commitment or financial advice.
